user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with a very long guest name so that the system handles long string inputs gracefully.

positive.title: Create booking with a very long guest name within acceptable limits
steps: Enter a guest name with 255 characters.
positive.expected_result: Booking is successfully created, guest name is displayed in full.

negative.title: Attempt to create booking with a guest name exceeding acceptable limits
steps: Enter a guest name with 256 characters.
Attempt to complete the booking process.
negative.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating guest name length exceeds the maximum allowed.

edge.title: Create booking with an empty guest name
steps: Leave the guest name field empty.
Attempt to complete the booking process.
edge.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating the guest name field cannot be empty.
